title: The gull, two strokes
logline: A gull on the seawall drawn in two strokes at the page's center, the way the margin mark drew it for twenty-three years, and the rest of the page the bay in full wash. The mark as a subject, once.

panels.composition: A gull on a seawall drawn in exactly two ink strokes at the center of a page otherwise given to a full wash of gray bay and sky.
